crossRefs.note: Yahweh said to him, “Call his name Jezreel; for yet a little while, and I will avenge the blood of Jezreel on the house…
The children of Judah and the children of Israel will be gathered together, and they will appoint themselves one head…

people.name: Jezreel
people.line: A city in Issachar, associated with Ahab and Jezebel

translations.web: and the earth will respond to the grain, and the new wine, and the oil; and they will respond to Jezreel.
translations.bsb: And the earth will respond to the grain, to the new wine and oil, and they will respond to Jezreel.
translations.kjv: And the earth shall hear the corn, and the wine, and the oil; and they shall hear Jezreel.
translations.asv: and the earth shall answer the grain, and the new wine, and the oil; and they shall answer Jezreel.
